blocks.title: Don't let your supply chain get you down.
blocks.intro: We make sure things are going as planned.

elements.html: Vendor site inspection is inspection performed at the site of your supplier, designed to make sure you’re getting what you ordered. Sometimes called “second-party inspection,” it is inspection done on behalf of the buyer, acting as their “eyes and ears” on the shop floor.

KLL can act as your on-site quality control team, giving you a coordinated, global approach to vendor site inspection in the upstream, downstream, power, marine and industrial manufacturing sectors.

We can work with you to develop customised inspection test plans (ITPs) that help you avoid common manufacturing risks that come with international miscommunicaton, unclear instructions, or time zone complications.

 We deliver timely intelligence reports that help keep your project on time, or allow you to make adjustments to production schedules based on site manufacturing issues.

Using a combination of LR surveyors and LR approved specialists, you get the benefit of our long history of providing third-party inspection services. Our teams have experience inspecting safety critical assets across the supply chain, including:

  • Pressure vessels and boilers
  • Pressure equipment accessories
  • Piping and valves
  • Electrical systems
  • Rotating equipment and pumps
  • Machinery and mechanical equipment
  • Containers
  • Port cranes
  • Lifting equipment and appliances
